title: Cancellation, Credit and Refund Terms — Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
Cancellation terms of Rental Property Service Contracts. Figures named here are the same on every tier: a free-look period of 30 days, an admin fee of $50.00 waived on a sale cancellation, a sale cancellation window of 60 days and a refund period of 30 days.

**C1. Notice and confirmation.** A cancellation starts when the landlord gives notice: the agent records a cancellation request whose notice date is the date the landlord gives notice, with the reason given and, for a sale, the property sale closing date the landlord states, and the landlord then confirms it. A contract is cancelled only after the landlord has confirmed the cancellation request on file; the request's status on file is the record read.

**C2 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "The cancellation is effective on the notice date and never backdated." This clause is superseded by the current basis: for a monthly-billed contract cancelled because the property was sold, the cancellation stays effective on the notice date but the credit's unused days may be counted from the day after the sale closing under the sale cancellation credit basis, and only for such a credit; every other cancellation remains effective on the notice date with nothing counted before it.

**C3. Free look.** Within the first term, a notice given no later than the free-look period in calendar days after the start date is credited all premium paid for the term less the benefit paid in the term, with no admin fee. The days are counted from the day after the start date through the notice date.

**C4. Annual-billed, after the free look.** Otherwise an annual-billed contract is credited the premium paid in the term times the unexpired term days divided by the term days, rounded to the cent, less the cancellation admin fee, less the benefit paid in the term.

**C5 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "Otherwise a monthly-billed contract is credited nothing for installments already billed, carries no admin fee and is billed no further installments." This clause is superseded by the current basis: for a monthly-billed contract cancelled because the property was sold, the unused share of the installment for the billing period in which notice was given is credited under the sale cancellation credit basis, and only for such a cancellation; every other monthly-billed cancellation is still credited nothing for installments already billed, and no admin fee and no further installment applies to either.

**C6. Sale waiver.** The admin fee is waived when the tier waives it on a sale and the request gives the reason that the property was sold.

**C7 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "The sale waiver applies only when notice is given no later than the sale cancellation window in calendar days after the property sale closes, counting from the day after the property sale closing date with the boundary day included." This clause is superseded by the current basis: the sale-waiver window conditions only the admin fee of a cancellation credit, so it is not applied to a billing-correction credit, and only to such a credit; every cancellation credit that carries an admin fee remains subject to this window. The closing date rests on the landlord's statement recorded on the request; the notice date is the request's own record.

**C8.** A credit is never negative and the difference is never billed. Service call fees are never returned through a cancellation, and cancelling one contract never changes the portfolio discount already set on the landlord's other contracts for their current terms.

**C9 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "A cancellation credit is posted only after the landlord has confirmed the cancellation request on file." This clause is superseded by the current basis: the condition that a premium credit waits on a confirmed cancellation request binds cancellation credits only, so a billing-correction credit is posted without one, and only such a credit; every cancellation credit remains posted only after the landlord has confirmed the cancellation request on file.

**C10 (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "Only one cancellation credit and one refund are posted per cancellation request." This clause is superseded by the current basis: the count of one credit and one refund per cancellation request covers cancellation credits only, so a billing-correction credit, which names no cancellation request, is not counted against it, and only such a credit is exempt; every cancellation credit remains limited to one, with one refund, per cancellation request.

**C11.** Any credit balance is refunded within the refund period in calendar days after confirmation.

## Quantities used in C3 and C4

| Quantity | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Premium paid for the term | premium payments posted from the term start date through the notice date, less returned payments billed back in that window |
| Unexpired term days | calendar days from the day after the notice date through the term end date |
| Term days | calendar days from the term start date through the term end date, both included |
| Benefit paid in the term | benefit authorizations on the contract for requests in the term, less the reversals of those authorizations |
| Days since start (C3) | calendar days from the day after the start date through the notice date |
| Days since closing (C7) | calendar days from the day after the closing date through the notice date; never qualifying when the request does not give the sold-property reason |

## Worked examples (hypothetical contracts)

1. First term, notice on day 20 after the start date, $666.80 paid, no benefit: free look, credit **$666.80**, no admin fee. Notice on day 30 is still free look; day 31 is not.
2. Annual-billed, after the free look, $666.80 paid, 146 of 365 days unexpired, $100.00 benefit paid: $666.80 times 146 divided by 365 is $266.72; less $50.00 and less $100.00, the credit is **$116.72**.
3. As example 2, with the reason that the property was sold and notice on day 40 after the closing: the admin fee is waived and the credit is **$166.72**. With notice on day 61 after the closing, the fee stands.
4. As example 2 but with $400.00 of benefit paid: $266.72 less $50.00 less $400.00 is below zero, so the credit is **$0.00** and nothing is billed.
